TeX-1500
	

TeX-1500 is a paired long-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging (LWIR HSI)
dataset for temperature-emissivity-texture (TeX) decomposition. The associated
paper describes 1,522 calibrated real-scene HSI-TeX pairs from DARPA pushbroom
data and our FTIR acquisitions. Each full dataset sample pairs calibrated LWIR
HSI with wavelength information, temperature, emissivity, and texture labels.
